sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.
2. The petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 328 C / 2018 for the offence under Sections 406, 420, 465, 468, 471 and 120(B) of IPC and Section 138 of N.I. Act.

3. As per the complaint petition, co-accused Zakir Hussain took Rs. 29,52,000/- from the complainant for opening four Madarsa, which was to be run by his NGO, in which co- accused Md.
Imtiyaz Ahmed told himself as coordinator, Zakir Hussain as Secretary and petitioner as staff and cheated the complainant and others.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.
He further submits that petitioner was only the driver of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.34546 of 2023(2) dt.21-07-2023 the co-accused Dr. Jakir Hussain and he has no concern with the alleged offence.

Petitioner has no criminal antecedent and similarly situated co-accused persons, namely, Rabeya Khatoon @ Rabiya Khatoon and Alauddin Ansari @ Md.
Alauddin Ansari have been granted anticipatory bail by a Coordinate Bench of this Court vide orders dated 30.08.2022 and 29.09.2022 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 22627 of 2022 and 36601 of 2022 respectively.
